title: CrowdStrike fiscal Q1 2027 Form 10-Q
excerpt: At April 30, 2026 CrowdStrike reported USD 4.553 billion cash, USD 745.8 million long-term debt, 254.537 million pre-split shares outstanding, and pro-forma split-adjusted diluted weighted-average shares of 1.031524 billion for the quarter.
summary: The SEC-filed quarterly report supports instrument economics, liquidity, dilution, cash generation, incident risk, and split-adjusted valuation inputs.
